name: The Demon Forge
label: Quest
description: The Demon Forge: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Lorax makes deals, he does not accept them from insignificant mortals.

A deal I shall make with you, however... Take this pike, it is imbued with powerful Fel energies. When you find Goraluk Anvilcrack, slay him and drive this pike through his dying heart. His soul he bartered, his soul I shall have. Return the pike and return the breastplate that the thief stole and I shall teach you what it is that he was to learn.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Our pact you did not break. The soul I did take. The reward I shall make.
